blocking_requirements: A deterministic task tokenization and serialization contract for the JSONL synthetic surfaces has not been frozen.
No stage-compatible training executable currently consumes those JSONL surfaces; the historical capability-pilot executable requires the unavailable historical replay parquet and cannot be reused.
The newly selected TRAIN and evaluation bytes have not been mounted and hash-verified on RunPod, so a complete remote preflight cannot truthfully pass.
why_no_gpu_or_data_substitution: The new condition must freeze a real executable and mounted bytes before GPU authorization. Reusing the replay-dependent historical executable or inventing an unreviewed serializer would weaken the distinct-condition contract.
